_about: Ranger licence & Fragment case (List 11 #98). The licence stores IDENTITY FACTS ONLY and renders standings by calling the owning derivations at read time (#12 flag popcounts, #14 dex counts, #100 gauntlet standing) — it keeps no second ledger (rule inherited from #45). The Fragment case is a VIEW: a slot is lit iff its progress.* clear flag exists; there is no fragment item or inventory. Display strings resolve via #23 lookups (rename law; region displays as Iridescence).
